title: Measurement Specification Is Not Evidence
summary: A map separating a measure definition, empty intake envelope, reviewed observation, compatible series point, admitted cohort, and bounded outcome.
map_question: What must happen between a measurement definition and a reader-visible outcome?
interpretation_boundary: The nodes are separate governed objects, not an automatic pipeline. A specification, envelope, observation, series point, cohort, and outcome each require their own evidence and decision.

nodes.label: Measurement specification
nodes.note: Defines entity, numerator, denominator, unit, period, method, exceptions, revisions, and propagation.

nodes.label: Empty intake envelope
nodes.note: Reserves no value, receipt, source attempt, decision, or publication state.

nodes.label: Reviewed observation
nodes.note: A real same-entity artifact passes all eighteen fields and independent review.

nodes.label: Break adjudication
nodes.note: Compatibility, bridge, segmentation, rejection, and blocker decisions preserve changed fields.

nodes.label: Compatible series point
nodes.note: One accepted observation joins an existing series only after every compatibility and break test.

nodes.label: Admitted cohort
nodes.note: A human decision admits an exact entity and measure contract; no Phase 69 cohort is admitted.

nodes.label: Bounded outcome
nodes.note: An admitted compatible series may support one scoped outcome without implying comparison or causation.

links.note: The envelope inherits one exact specification and its required fields.
A reviewed observation must expose every prospective break before joining a series.
No actual break or bridge decision exists because no observation exists.
A series point cannot admit a cohort automatically.
Admission is not an outcome and no admitted cohort exists.

what_this_map_supports: Separate public contracts for measurement, intake, break review, series membership, cohort admission, and outcomes.
Fail-closed handling of missing fields, hidden breaks, forced bridges, and automatic admission.
Useful empty-state publication without inventing a value.
what_this_map_does_not_prove: It does not establish that any observation or qualifying artifact exists.
It does not convert an empty envelope into an attempted check.
It does not create a value, trend, score, rank, comparison, causation, or outcome.
next_records_needed: A real same-entity artifact satisfying one exact measurement specification.
An independently reviewed eighteen-field observation intake.
A bounded break, bridge, segmentation, or compatibility decision before series membership.
